privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At My Call Insurance, your privacy is very important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website and services.
privacy.collectText: We may collect personal information such as your name, phone number, email address, and other details voluntarily provided through contact forms or service requests.
privacy.useText: The information we collect is used to provide personalized services, respond to inquiries, improve customer support, and comply with legal requirements.
privacy.shareText: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties except when necessary to provide our services, comply with the law, or with your prior consent.
privacy.cookiesText: Our website may use cookies to enhance user experience, analyze traffic, and personalize content. You can disable cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.securityText: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information. However, no system is completely secure and absolute protection cannot be guaranteed.
privacy.childrenText: Our services are intended only for individuals 18 years of age or older. We do not knowingly collect information from minors.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal information in accordance with applicable laws.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the information provided on this website.
